fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: A description of the backup with 2048 characters or less.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The name of the location of the instance.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The resource name of the backup.

fields.label: Source File Share
fields.help: Name of the file share in the source Cloud Filestore instance that the backup is created from.

fields.label: Source Instance
fields.help: The resource name of the source Cloud Filestore instance, in the format projects/{projectId}/locations/{locationId}/instances/{instanceId}, used to create this backup.
